subject: Bridge approval request: sign-on top-up for candidate Kai Zhou
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bridge approval request: sign-on top-up for candidate Kai Zhou

Team —

Quick context: we have an offer on the table for Kai Zhou (Data Infra Lead). Candidate has 10+ years infra experience, three relevant FAANG offers referenced, and strong production ML infra background. He indicated he needs a competitive sign-on to bridge two competing offers; compensation discussion pushed beyond our band ceiling for Senior IC.

Current proposed package (standard for role): base $220k, target equity 0.5% (4-year, 1y cliff), no sign-on. Candidate countered asking for $40k sign-on + equity refresh to 0.6%. Recruiting and I pushed leveraging band, but candidate has a firm deadline (end of week) and will likely accept elsewhere without a top-up.

Request: one-time exception approval for a sign-on payment of $40,000 and an equity refresh to 0.6% (grant to be treated as a one-time top-up, backfilled to existing grant schedule). I attached the offer calc and a short manager justification. Approvals requested by EOD Monday so we can send the final offer. If we need to trade (lower sign-on / slightly less equity), Vivek has suggested $35k + 0.55% as an alternative.

Attachments: kai_zhou_offer_calc.xlsx; manager_justification.txt

Why this matters briefly:
- Candidate fills a critical infra ownership gap on inference runtime (low ramp risk)
- Hard to hire in this market; losing Kai will push project timeline by one quarter
- Team has an open headcount approved for Q2 (HC already allocated)

Ask: Mina/Laura — can you confirm whether comp committee approves a one-time bridge sign-on at the levels above? Vivek — anything to add on negotiation flexibility?

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Recruiting Partner | Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0123
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge approval request: sign-on top-up for candidate Kai Zhou

Thanks Rachel — good summary. A couple of quick clarifying Qs before I take this to comp committee: 
1) Is the HC already headcount-approved for Q2 (you said yes, can you confirm cost center + hiring code)?
2) Is the $40k sign-on gross (paid over 1 payout) and subject to clawback if candidate leaves within 12 months? Our standard policy has a 12-month clawback for sign-on loans.
3) Have we run this against the band/market comp tool? If so, where does Kai land relative to midpoint/upper quartile (I want to see salary + total first-year cash + realized OTE).

If the answers are yes and it's fundable within the allocated HC, I'm inclined to move forward; I want to propose we cap the sign-on at $35k with a 0.4% equity bump to keep overall long-term dilution in check. Can Vivek confirm the candidate's tolerance for variance?

Cc'ing Laura for visibility.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Talent | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge approval request: sign-on top-up for candidate Kai Zhou

Appreciate the flag. Short answers inline: 
- HC: confirmed, hiring code HC-IR-3472 on Infra group ledger (paul.finance confirmed available).
- Sign-on: planned as a one-time gross payout in first paycheck; team will use standard 12-month clawback.
- Band: Kai is above midpoint for base but below top-of-band for total comp given multiple competing offers; attached is a short excerpt from the candidate's negotiation email showing competing numbers.

On tolerance: Kai told me directly he'd accept provided we close the gap on guaranteed cash. His preference is sign-on over a slightly larger equity because he needs to cover a relocation/notice period. If forced to choose, he would accept $35k + 0.55% but prefers $40k + 0.6%. We are under time pressure — deadline Tuesday COB next week.

Forwarded attachment: candidate_email_excerpt.txt

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Inference Infrastructure | Redwood Inference

Thanks all for the quick context and the docs. I've reviewed the HC confirmation and Vivek's notes. Given the timeline and the role criticality I'm willing to approve a one-time exception with the following conditions: 

 - Sign-on: APPROVED at $35,000 (gross, one-time payout)
 - Equity: APPROVED at 0.55% one-time refresh (treated as supplemental to standard grant; follow-up to comp ops to finalize sizing)
 - Clawback: 12-month standard clawback applies
 - Finance to confirm final cash flow treatment; payroll must record as 'sign-on bonus' with code SGB-2027

Rachel / Vivek: please proceed to send the revised offer with numbers above and include the standard clawback language. Mina: please file this with comp committee minutes — I'll mark as approved under 'expedited hiring exceptions' and log rationale (critical infra hire, high competition).

I'll follow up if Finance pushes back on payout timing; but for now this is an approval to proceed. Good catch on the deadline — let's get this turned today.
